node: Assessment, credentialing, identity verification, and remote proctoring infrastructure
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the trusted-verification node in education. The clearest public reference anchor is Pearson via Pearson VUE, OnVUE, and Credly. The underfollowed lane is stronger in niche healthcare workforce credentialing and horizontal identity-verification infrastructure than in pure-play remote proctoring, because many direct proctoring leaders such as Prometric, ETS, Meazure/ProctorU, PSI, and Kryterion appear private or non-US-listed. Best Layer 1B additions are Pearson, Duolingo, HealthStream, and Mitek Systems; only Pearson and HealthStream have clearly documented credentialing/workforce verification assets, while Mitek is a second-order identity-verification supplier hypothesis requiring education/proctoring customer proof.
